config.scope: Original chordal network field regularized in3D with a source-localized weak inner-RV fringe above priorZ1020 crop. Higher-signal coherent walls and cords remain source-derived; no blanket raw190 immunity. Smooth collars preserve original scalar field at all six boxfaces. C1 convex serial interpolation and smooth-priority union avoid derivative discontinuities at section anchors and zone intersections.

candidatePatches.method: Local coherent-opening source-field regularization and source-contrast extraction with smoothly interpolated serial polygon weights. No unconditional bright-voxel immunity; genuine surfaces judged by neighboring source continuity.
limitations: Reversible educational display reconstruction, not a clinical tissue label.
Original measurement bank and native mesh remain unchanged.
Fine-grid source cannot recover native19.85µm structure.
Unwelded collar matches the original scalar field.
